stripe_accounts as (
    select
        * rename (_union_branch as stripe_account_code)
    from unioned
),

reconciled as (
    (
with incoming_assertions as (
    select
        *,
        DEV_FINANCE_GENERAL_UTILITIES.functions.normalize_timestamp(sysdate()) as _upstream__queried_at
    from stripe_accounts
    where true
      and _self__asserted_at >= dateadd(minute, -60, (select coalesce(max(_upstream__queried_at), '1900-01-01'::timestamp_ntz) from DEV_FINANCE_GENERAL_STAGING.stripe.transfer_reversal))
),

arrivals as (
    select
        * exclude (_etl__loaded_at, _self__asserted_at),
        DEV_FINANCE_GENERAL_UTILITIES.functions.normalize_timestamp(sysdate()) as _self__asserted_at,
        '8ac5cab9-3117-4124-8cfe-14ccdf69810f' as _etl__process_id,
        DEV_FINANCE_GENERAL_UTILITIES.functions.normalize_timestamp('2026-10-03 19:51:33.454986+00:00') as _etl__loaded_at,
        false as _self__is_retracted
    from incoming_assertions
),

subjects as (
    select transfer_reversal_hk from incoming_assertions
),

stored_before as (
    select * from DEV_FINANCE_GENERAL_STAGING.stripe.transfer_reversal
    where exists (select 1 from subjects where subjects.transfer_reversal_hk = DEV_FINANCE_GENERAL_STAGING.stripe.transfer_reversal.transfer_reversal_hk)
      and not _self__is_retracted
),

stored_sequence as (
    select transfer_reversal_hk, max(_origin__version_sequence) as _origin__version_sequence
    from stored_before
    where not _state__is_absent
    group by 1
),

repaired_arrivals as (
    select arrivals.* replace (
        case
            when arrivals._state__is_absent and stored_sequence._origin__version_sequence is not null
                then left(stored_sequence._origin__version_sequence, length(stored_sequence._origin__version_sequence) - 1) || '1'
            else arrivals._origin__version_sequence
        end as _origin__version_sequence
    )
    from arrivals
    left join stored_sequence on stored_sequence.transfer_reversal_hk = arrivals.transfer_reversal_hk
),

candidates as (
    select * from repaired_arrivals
    union all
    select * from stored_before
),

latest_asserted_timeline_points as (
    select * from candidates
    qualify rank() over (
        partition by transfer_reversal_hk, _state__valid_at
        order by _origin__version_sequence desc
    ) = 1
),

timeline_points_with_previous_hash as (
    select
        *,
        lag(_state__hash) over (
            partition by transfer_reversal_hk
            order by _state__valid_at asc
        ) as _prev_hash
    from latest_asserted_timeline_points
),

transitions as (
    select * exclude (_prev_hash)
    from timeline_points_with_previous_hash
    where _prev_hash is distinct from _state__hash
),

held as (
    select * from stored_before
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by transfer_reversal_hk, _state__valid_at
        order by _self__asserted_at desc
    ) = 1
),

withdrawals as (
    select * replace (
        true as _self__is_retracted,
        DEV_FINANCE_GENERAL_UTILITIES.functions.normalize_timestamp(sysdate()) as _self__asserted_at,
        '8ac5cab9-3117-4124-8cfe-14ccdf69810f' as _etl__process_id,
        DEV_FINANCE_GENERAL_UTILITIES.functions.normalize_timestamp('2026-10-03 19:51:33.454986+00:00') as _etl__loaded_at
    )
    from held
    where not exists (
        select 1 from transitions
        where transitions.transfer_reversal_hk = held.transfer_reversal_hk
          and transitions._state__valid_at = held._state__valid_at
    )
),

timeline as (
    select * from transitions
    where not exists (
        select 1 from held
        where held.transfer_reversal_hk = transitions.transfer_reversal_hk
          and held._state__valid_at = transitions._state__valid_at
          and held._state__hash = transitions._state__hash
    )
    union all
    select * from withdrawals
)

select * from timeline
)
),

final as (
    select * from reconciled

)
